headlines.description: — Anthony Davis had 34 points and 12 rebounds in his debut with Washington, and the new-look Wizards beat the Milwaukee Bucks 128-116 on Wednesday night in the season opener for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Davis scores 34 points in his Washington debut, leading the Wizards over Milwaukee 128-116
